nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The Sage sent word about that old door. Whatever is down there, give it hell. I will keep watch up here -- governor's orders.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The Sage sent word you would be coming back. The hut door is open for you. But I will say -- something felt wrong in there even after the rats were cleared. A cold draft from somewhere deep.

actions.value: The Guard unlocks the hut door for you.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: Good work clearing those rats. The hut is locked up again -- governor wants it sealed until the Sage finishes his inspection. Talk to the Sage if there is anything else.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: The Sage sent you to deal with the rats? About time someone with a weapon showed up. I have unlocked the hut door -- go on through. Watch yourself in there, they bite.

actions.value: The Guard unlocks the hut door.

nodes.speaker: Guard
nodes.text: By order of the governor, this hut is sealed. Rat infestation -- too dangerous for civilians. The Sage is handling the investigation. Talk to him if you have business here.
